summary: Vibe Kanban: best OSS runner UI (10+ executors, mature worktrees) but flat kanban with zero deps/memory — and it SHUT DOWN 2026-04-10, orphaning its user base. Claude Squad: tmux+worktree window manager, no task entity beyond a title, no sharing — not an orchestrator. Conductor (v0.64): the polished manual switchboard — parallel worktree agents with great review UX but no scheduling, no cross-task context, no memory, closed-source Mac-only. claude-flow/Ruflo: only competitor with a measured learning loop, but its own repo audit caught fabricated benchmarks (Math.random() speedups) and the loop learns routing, not knowledge; memory is unfused from its ephemeral DAG and it has no worktree isolation. Sweep: Beads/Gas Town is the closest honest knowledge+work-graph fusion (Dolt issue graph + bd remember/prime, no learning, no bi-temporality); Sculptor/Omnara are isolation/remote-control plays; Terragon and Crystal are dead; Cursor 3 and GitHub Agent HQ are commoditizing the runner layer from above. Biggest exploitable gap: NOBODY does typed-edge token-economic context handoff or a trustworthy work-graph-coupled learning loop — "tasks that remember" is unoccupied, while the runner layer is a proven graveyard. Full findings: /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/scratch/competitive/B2-orchestrator-competitors.md

item.value: Vibe Kanban (BloopAI) shut down 2026-04-10 (no business model; now community-maintained). Code confirms: flat kanban Task model (crates/db/src/models/task.rs), zero dependency/DAG concepts, no memory/knowledge store; only cross-task context is get_execution's final_message string. Strongest assets: 10+ agent executors and battle-hardened worktree-manager crate.

claude-flow/Ruflo (v3.10.40, active) is the only competitor with a measured self-learning loop, but its own repo audit (docs/reviews/intelligence-system-audit-2026-05-29.md) found fabricated benchmarks (Flash Attention speedup = Math.random() at runtime), hardcoded recall constants, inert WASM LoRA, and a critical bug where negative reward reinforced bad agents. Loop is real but narrow (routing/pattern confidence), memory (.swarm/memory.db) is NOT fused with its ephemeral in-memory task DAG, and it has no worktree isolation.

Closest honest competitor to knowledge-graph-fused-work-graph is Steve Yegge's Beads + Gas Town/Gas City (v1.0 Apr 2026): dependency-aware issue graph stored in Dolt, bd remember/bd prime memory injection, semantic compaction of closed tasks. Gaps vs orchestrator: no bi-temporality, no learning loop, injection is global not edge-scoped, hostile UX ('Stage 7-8 developers only').

No Tier-2 orchestrator does typed-edge, token-economic (two-tier) context handoff between tasks — verified across Vibe Kanban, Claude Squad, Conductor, claude-flow, Sculptor, Omnara, Cursor 3, Factory, GitHub Agent HQ. Closest analogues: Beads' compaction/prime and Vibe Kanban's final_message string. This is the orchestrator's most defensible differentiator as of 2026-06.

Runner-layer graveyard pattern Q1-Q2 2026: Vibe Kanban (Apr), Terragon (Jan 16), Crystal (Feb, pivoted to Nimbalyst) all shut down/pivoted — parallel-worktree running has zero pricing power and is being commoditized from above by GitHub Agent HQ (mission control, fleet of Claude/Codex/Jules/Devin, worktree-per-agent desktop app announced Build 2026-06-02) and Cursor 3 (agent-first IDE, Apr 2026). Strategic implication: orchestrator must position as the intelligence/memory layer, not compete as a runner UI.

item.note: Full B2 code-level competitive deep-dive: Vibe Kanban, Claude Squad, Conductor (v0.64), claude-flow/Ruflo, plus sweep (Gas Town/Beads, Sculptor, Omnara, Terragon, Crystal, Cursor 3, Factory, GitHub Agent HQ) with per-competitor have/lack/beat-us/how-we-win and synthesis.
